headline: Executive order aimed at speeding up federal environmental reviews and approvals for infrastructure projects labeled high priority.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to move faster on environmental reviews and approvals for infrastructure projects it considers high priority. No official summary was provided, so details are not available here, such as which projects qualify, who decides, or what deadlines apply.

who_it_affects.group: Companies and agencies building large infrastructure projects
who_it_affects.how: Projects labeled high priority may get federal environmental reviews and approvals finished sooner.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that do environmental reviews
who_it_affects.how: These agencies are expected to speed up their review and approval work for high-priority projects.

who_it_affects.group: People and communities near proposed infrastructure projects
who_it_affects.how: Reviews of projects in their area may follow a faster timeline.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 24, 2017; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
